title: Sensor stopped "No session in progress"
symptom: Sensor stopped unexpectedly, and after inserting a new one, phone and watch receive data but do not display readings. System status says 'got data' but no readings shown. After warmup, main screen shows 'collecting data' for hours. Logs show 'Raw values not changing-blocking further processing', Task deadlocks, and 'noBG? COULDN'T FIND SLOPE'. After another sensor restart during warmup, initial calibrations appeared on menu tab, and readings started appearing, but xDrip still says 'sensor stopped'.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. The user speculates it might be due to the activated 'Fallback to xDrip' option, but no confirmation. The issue was closed due to inactivity without a confirmed cause.
fix: One commenter (apeterson22) provided a workaround: Stop Sensor, Start Sensor using code 0000 for 15-20 mins, Forget Device, Restart phone, Stop sensor, start sensor with correct old 4 digit code. After 1.7 hr warm up data flows. The user also considered deleting the app and reinstalling without importing settings, but no official fix was given.
settings_changed: Fallback to xDrip → activated (mentioned as possibly causing issue)
Start Sensor code → correct old 4 digit code
evidence_quote: Here's how I got my son's to work: 1) Stop Sensor 2) Start Sensor using code 0000 for 15-20 mins 3) Forget Device 4) Restart phone 5) Stop sensor 6) start sensor with correct old 4 digit code After 1.7 hr warm up data if flowing.
